find: if (before !== undefined && before !== mapping) remapped = true;
why: The menu poller keeps held state per action, so a layout edit that moves an action onto a button already down would read that button as a new press. The Controller Layout pane makes that edit on every capture, with the chosen button still held: Back moved onto X closes the pane on the frame after X was chosen. A poll whose mapping changed adopts newly down actions as held instead.
killedBy: createGamepadMenuPoller: the player's layout (issue #754) adopts a button held across a layout change as held, not pressed, and reads it once pressed again
